before_publication.title: Re-enactments: authentic history or 'just dressing up'?
before_publication.author: Molly May Sherborne
content_observations: 1996-97 oral-history interviews recorded by Rachel Hasted for an MA dissertation
16 initial interviews; 12 archived and digitised at the British Library
article distinguishes prepared comparative questions from flexible follow-up
new inventory evidence prompted revision of a re-enacted character's economic background
personal experience entered character narratives; author treats authenticity and imaginative play as a contested boundary

after_publication.scope: HTML body and embedded transcript text re-read; full SoundCloud playback not tested.
